marketing_description: The ZIP System Rainscreen, part number 1501767, is a 4 ft x 8 ft panel with a 1/4 in thickness, featuring a Perm Rating of 7 perm and made from OSB material. It is designed to resist water and has a coverage area of 32 sq-ft. This panel is Tongue and Groove (T&G) and is available in a blue color.
